# New Feature

`saas/new-feature` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

A single feature spotlight in a card: optional image, badge, title, description and a link.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `badge` | text | `"New"` |
| `description` | text |  |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: A bordered card on the surface color.
- **tinted**: A card on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.lg"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Card background, border and padding honored. Rounded corners are square. | Fine. | Card background and text swap via dm-* classes on the brand surface. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/new-feature', {
  "badge": "New",
  "title": "Dark mode for the whole app",
  "description": "Switch it on in Settings, or let it follow your device.",
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/520x260/png?text=Dark%20mode",
    "alt": "The app dashboard shown in dark mode"
  },
  "cta": {
    "label": "See how to switch",
    "href": "https://example.com/help/dark-mode"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "saas/new-feature",
  "data": {
    "badge": "New",
    "title": "Dark mode for the whole app",
    "description": "Switch it on in Settings, or let it follow your device.",
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/520x260/png?text=Dark%20mode",
      "alt": "The app dashboard shown in dark mode"
    },
    "cta": {
      "label": "See how to switch",
      "href": "https://example.com/help/dark-mode"
    }
  }
}
```
